notes.title: DEV UPDATE 4: Relase date postponed & Beta
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We regret to inform you that the release date of "Dreamless: the Madness from the Sea" has been postponed due to time-related development issues. We are pleased to announce that the game is practically complete, however we wish to dedicate enough time to the debugging phase, including a beta test.

It is important for us to guarantee a pleasant player experience and in order to do that we have to gather additional feedback on gameplay and game balance.

On October 27th, we will begin beta testing and provide access codes to a selection of interested players. To participate, please fill out the form at the following link:

https://forms.gle/Q6Jydv8sF1wpQusy8

We'll accept applications until October 1st. 

The release date has been moved by only a few months, and the game is now expected in Q1 2024.

Thank you for your patience and support.

Sleepy Cat Games Team

notes.title: DEV UPDATE 1: New game graphics
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Quick update: we know it's been a while.
We have been working tirelessly for you and for the betterment of this game.

This truly is a two person project and we are doing all we can to finish it for you as soon as possible... so we had to tweak the graphics a little bit so that we could work faster and more efficiently.

Here are some pictures of the game's new look: soon we'll come up with a video to show you what we've done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37800920/721e6282c4f669e7987d973cd20083846a28d649.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37800920/bb3d7aa4bce57c6ee12df02c737fbd038acd50fe.png[/img]

We can't deny that this is an ambitious project, in fact there will be lots of creatures and bosses for you to fight and we promise that the world map won't disappoint you.

Ultimately, we are considering starting a Kickstarter so that we can involve more people in the production and manage the amount of work.
We'll keep you updated!
